purpose: Exact byte-pinned addendum for structurally valid post-cutover Driver reviews that contain no source-backed Driver authority pin. Preserve immutable review history while withholding operational review/follow-up authority; do not invent or backdate authority.

allowed_authority_errors: driver_authority_record_id does not pin active authority
entries.reason: The immutable current-schema review names a Driver but contains no driver_authority_record_id/source-comment pin. Control-plane maintenance cannot infer or backdate source-backed Driver authority, so the exact review remains history and the Result returns to ordinary authorized Driver review.
